description:
Check out JMP’s workshop here: https://www.jmp.com/scishow-dataviz 

You might remember the power pose. The idea, popular in the early 2010s, that if you hold the Superman position your body reacts in ways that make you feel more confidence. The idea has been thoroughly debunked, and partially redeemed -- and teaches us something about how we should do psychology in the future.

Hosted by: Niba @NotesbyNiba (she/her)
